name: Rejection
overview: Scripture reveals that rejection, whether from family or others, is met with God's unfailing care and presence. When earthly relationships fail, the LORD promises to gather and uphold His people, never forsaking or casting them off. The imagery of the rejected stone becoming the cornerstone illustrates how God can transform rejection into a position of honor and purpose. Even in the womb, God intimately knows and values each person, assuring us that His compassion and remembrance surpass human abandonment.
